# Separating a forward's skill from his team

This is a project I made with my son Wyatt. It adapts the Soccer Factor Model of Andorra and Göbel ([2024](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.05911)) to ten seasons of public data from Europe's top five leagues, 2014/15 to 2023/24. Each of 593 forwards gets four correlated skills: how often he shoots, where he shoots from, how well he finishes, and how many chances he creates. A Mundlak term separates the forward's skill from the strength of the teams he plays for. The model is fitted in PyMC.

- [The explorer](../../football_models_with_wyatt/index.qmd): player cards, head-to-head comparisons and a question jar for Wyatt, with rankings, correlations and career curves for grown-ups.
- [How it works](../../football_models_with_wyatt/model.qmd): the paper's model, what we changed and why, posterior predictive checks, and findings.
- [Reproduction notebook](https://github.com/NathanielF/NathanielF.github.io/blob/master/football_models_with_wyatt/reproduce.ipynb): the whole model in plain PyMC from one 0.4 MB table, with a parameter-recovery test.
- [Code](https://github.com/NathanielF/NathanielF.github.io/tree/master/football_models_with_wyatt): the data pipeline, model, exports and tests.
